euroc.long: grayscale 752x480 frame replicated to three channels, fed as recorded with the radial-tangential distortion left in, cam0 intrinsics passed to Metric3D

tumvi.long: 512x512 equidistant fisheye rectified with cv2.fisheye.initUndistortRectifyMap, R = I, to a 512x512 pinhole view of 90 degrees, f = 256.0 px, then replicated to three channels. Keypoints are unprojected with ucslam.calib and projected into that view.

not_done: UniDepth was not run. The manuscript table lists it, and no wrapper exists for it.

The reference is stereo triangulation with a first-order covariance, not a depth sensor. Its noise is subtracted in variance. A stereo extrinsic error would be a shared error that this deflation does not remove.

network_labels.da2-metric-indoor-small: Depth Anything V2 metric indoor, ViT-S
network_labels.da2-metric-indoor-base: Depth Anything V2 metric indoor, ViT-B
